response.text: {"label": "misread_spec", "reason": "The target needs rst re-asserted on the exact cycle a good stop bit is sampled, followed by a fresh 5A frame; the gold does this with a mid-run reset before `78 ... rx hs 5a`, but the sub only resets once at start and never pulses rst again. Its rxd is also left unconnected, so the DUT sees a constant low line (sub `3 ... rx busy_rise 0` then `78 ... rx frame_error 1` repeating every 76 cycles), no 5A ever appears, and the wait hangs until timeout."}
